WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: layers
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The layer or layers to display (comma separated values).

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: styles
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The styles to use with each of the Layer(s) (comma separated values). This maps one-to-one with Layer(s)

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: crs
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: CRS to use with WMS layers. We support Web Mercator (EPSG:3857, EPSG:900913) and WGS 84 (EPSG:4326, CRS:84, EPSG:4283)

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: dimensions
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Dimension parameters used to request a particular layer along one or more dimensional axes (including elevation, excluding time). Do not include _dim prefx for parameter keys. These dimensions will be applied to all layers (if applicable)

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: availableStyles
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The available styles.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: availableDimensions
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The available dimensions.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: parameters
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Additional parameters to pass WMS GetMap and GetFeatureInfo requests. Style parameters are stored as CSV in styles, dimension parameters are stored in dimensions.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: maxRefreshIntervals
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The maximum number of discrete times that can be created by a single date range, when specified in the format time/time/periodicity. E.g. 2015-04-27T16:15:00/2015-04-27T18:45:00/PT15M has 11 times.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: disableDimensionSelectors
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: When true, disables the dimension selectors in the workbench.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: isGeoServer
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: True if this WMS is a GeoServer; otherwise, false.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: isEsri
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: True if this WMS is from Esri; otherwise, false.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: isThredds
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: True if this WMS is from a THREDDS server; otherwise, false.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: isNcWMS
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: True if this WMS supports NcWMS.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: supportsColorScaleRange
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Gets or sets whether this WMS server has been identified as supporting the COLORSCALERANGE parameter.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: supportsGetLegendGraphic
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Gets or sets whether this WMS server supports GetLegendGraphic requests.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: supportsGetTimeseries
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Gets or sets whether this WMS server supports GetTimeseries requests. If true, then GetTimeseries will be used instead of GetFeatureInfo. This will also set default value of getFeatureInfoFormat to { format: "text/csv", type: "text" }

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: colorScaleMinimum
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The minimum of the color scale range. Because COLORSCALERANGE is a non-standard property supported by ncWMS servers, this property is ignored unless WebMapServiceCatalogItem's supportsColorScaleRange is true. WebMapServiceCatalogItem's colorScaleMaximum must be set as well.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: colorScaleMaximum
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The maximum of the color scale range. Because COLORSCALERANGE is a non-standard property supported by ncWMS servers, this property is ignored unless WebMapServiceCatalogItem's supportsColorScaleRange is true. WebMapServiceCatalogItem's colorScaleMinimum must be set as well.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: useWmsVersion130
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Use WMS version 1.3.0. True by default (unless url has "version=1.1.1" or "version=1.1.0"), if false, then WMS version 1.1.1 will be used.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: getFeatureInfoFormat
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Format parameter to pass to GetFeatureInfo requests. Defaults to "application/json", "application/vnd.ogc.gml", "text/html" or "text/plain" - depending on GetCapabilities response

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: getFeatureInfoUrl
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: If defined, this URL will be used for GetFeatureInfo requests instead of url.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: getFeatureInfoParameters
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Additional parameters to pass WMS GetFeatureInfo requests. If parameters trait is also defined, this is applied on top. Dimension parameters are stored in dimensions.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: attribution
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The attribution to display with the data.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: name
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The name of the catalog item.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: description
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The description of the catalog item. Markdown and HTML may be used.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: hideDefaultDescription
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: If true, then no generic default description will be displayed if description is undefined.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: nameInCatalog
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The name of the item to be displayed in the catalog, if it is different from the one to display in the workbench.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: info
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Human-readable information about this dataset.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: infoSectionOrder
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: An array of section titles defining the display order of info sections. If this property is not defined, {@link DataPreviewSections}'s DEFAULT_SECTION_ORDER is used

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: isOpenInWorkbench
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the item in the workbench open or collapsed.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: shortReport
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: A short report to show on the now viewing tab.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: shortReportSections
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: A list of collapsible sections of the short report

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: isExperiencingIssues
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the catalog item is experiencing issues which may cause its data to be unavailable

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: hideSource
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Indicates that the source of this data should be hidden from the UI (obviously this isn't super-secure as you can just look at the network requests).

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: metadataUrls
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Metadata URLs to show in data catalog.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: dataUrls
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Data URLs to show in data catalog.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: dataCustodian
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Gets or sets a description of the custodian of this data item.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: modelDimensions
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: This provides ability to set model JSON through SelectableDimensions (a dropdown). When an option is selected, the value property will be used to call updateModelFromJson(). All string properties support Mustache templates (with the catalog member as context)

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: disableAboutData
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Disables the 'About Data' button in the workbench.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: shareable
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: True (default) if this catalog member may be included in share links. False to exclude it from share links.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: workbenchControlFlags
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Flags for enabling or disabling workbench controls.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: chartType
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Type determines how the data availibility will be plotted on chart. eg: momentLines, momentPoints

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: chartDisclaimer
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: A HTML string to show above the chart as a disclaimer

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: chartColor
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The color to use when the data set is displayed on the chart. The value can be any html color string, eg: 'cyan' or '#00ffff' or 'rgba(0, 255, 255, 1)' for the color cyan.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: chartGlyphStyle
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The glyph style to use for points plotted on the chart. Allowed values include circle, cross, diamond, square, star, triangle, wye. Default is "circle".

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: availableDiffStyles
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: List of styles that can be used for computing difference image

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: isShowingDiff
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: True if currently showing diff image

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: firstDiffDate
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The first date to use to compute the difference image

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: secondDiffDate
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The second date to use to compute the difference image

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: diffStyleId
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The ID of the style used to compute the difference image

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: diffItemProperties
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Additional properties to set on the difference output item.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: fromContinuous
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description:
Specifies how a continuous time (e.g. the timeline control) is mapped to a discrete time for this dataset. Valid values are:
* nearest - the nearest available discrete time to the current continuous time is used.
* next - the discrete time equal to or after the current continuous time is used.
* previous - the discrete time equal to or before the current continuous time is used.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: showInChartPanel
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether to plot data availability on a chart.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: disableDateTimeSelector
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: When true, disables the date time selector in the workbench

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: multiplierDefaultDeltaStep
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The multiplierDefaultDeltaStep is used to set the default multiplier (see TimeVaryingTraits.multiplier trait) - it represents the average number of (real-time) seconds between (dataset) time steps. For example, a value of five would set the multiplier so that a new time step (of this dataset) would appear every five seconds (on average) if the timeline is playing. This trait will only take effect if multiplier is not explicitly set.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: linkedWcsUrl
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Gets or sets the URL of a WCS that enables clip-and-ship for this WMS item.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: linkedWcsCoverage
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Gets or sets the coverage name for linked WCS for clip-and-ship.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: linkedWcsParameters
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: WCS Parameters included in GetCoverage requests (for clip-and-ship).

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: disableExport
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Disable user export functionality

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: allowFeaturePicking
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Indicates whether features in this catalog item can be selected by clicking them on the map.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: getCapabilitiesUrl
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The URL at which to access to the OGC GetCapabilities service.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: getCapabilitiesCacheDuration
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The amount of time to cache GetCapabilities responses.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: leafletUpdateInterval
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Update a tile only once during this interval when the map is panned. Value should be specified in milliseconds.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: tileErrorHandlingOptions
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Options for handling tile errors

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: clipToRectangle
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this dataset should be clipped to the {@link CatalogItem#rectangle}.
If true, no part of the dataset will be displayed outside the rectangle.
This property is true by default, leading to better performance and avoiding tile request errors that might occur when requesting tiles outside the server-specified rectangle.
However, it may also cause features to be cut off in some cases, such as if a server reports an extent that does not take into account that the representation of features sometimes require a larger spatial extent than the features themselves.
For example, if a point feature on the edge of the extent is drawn as a circle with a radius of 5 pixels, half of that circle will be cut off.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: minimumLevel
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The minimum level-of-detail supported by the imagery provider. Take care when specifying this that the number of tiles at the minimum level is small, such as four or less. A larger number is likely to result in rendering problems

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: maximumLevel
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The maximum level-of-detail supported by the imagery provider, or undefined if there is no limit

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: tileWidth
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Tile width in pixels. Default value is 256 pixels

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: tileHeight
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Tile height in pixels. Default value is 256 pixels

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: keepOnTop
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Keeps the layer on top of all other imagery layers.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: supportsReordering
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Does this layer support reordering in the workbench.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: legends
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The legends to display on the workbench.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: legendBackgroundColor
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Apply background color to all legends. This can be useful if legends are transparent and clash with Terria colours

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: hideLegendInWorkbench
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the legend is hidden in the workbench for this catalog member.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: rectangle
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The bounding box rectangle that contains all the data in this catalog item.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: idealZoom
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Override default ideal zoom if the given values are valid.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: disablePreview
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Disables the preview on the Add Data panel. This is useful when the preview will be very slow to load.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: disableZoomTo
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Disables the zoom to (aka 'Ideal Zoom') button in the workbench.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: zoomOnAddToWorkbench
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Zoom to dataset when added to workbench. Doesn't work if disableZoomTo is true.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: show
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Show or hide a workbench item. When show is false, a mappable item is removed from the map and a chartable item is removed from the chart panel.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: initialMessage
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: A message to show when the user adds the catalog item to the workbench. Useful for showing disclaimers.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: featureInfoTemplate
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: A template object for formatting content in feature info panel

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: showStringIfPropertyValueIsNull
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: If the value of a property is null or undefined, show the specified string as the value of the property. Otherwise, the property name will not be listed at all.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: maximumShownFeatureInfos
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The maximum number of "feature infos" that can be displayed in feature info panel.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: preferredViewerMode
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The preferred viewer mode for this item - either '2d' '3d' or '3dsmooth'. If this dataset is used as a basemap then we automatically switch the viewer to the preferred mode. However the user can still switch to another mode, so this preference is not strongly enforced.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: maxScaleDenominator
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The denominator of the smallest scale (largest denominator) for which tiles should be requested. For example, if this value is 10000, then tiles representing a scale smaller than 1:10000 (i.e. numerically larger denominator, when zooming out further) will not be requested. For large scales set hideLayerBeforeMaxScaleDenominator to true, otherwise you may experience performance issues (requesting too many tiles).

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: minScaleDenominator
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The denominator of the largest scale (smallest denominator) for which tiles should be requested. For example, if this value is 1000, then tiles representing a scale larger than 1:1000 (i.e. numerically smaller denominator, when zooming in closer) will not be requested.  Instead, tiles of the largest-available scale, as specified by this property, will be used and will simply get blurier as the user zooms in closer.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: hideLayerAfterMinScaleDenominator
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: True to hide tiles when the Minimum Scale Denominator is exceeded. If false, we can zoom in arbitrarily close to the (increasingly blurry) layer.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: scaleWorkbenchInfo
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The message to show to the user when this dataset is not visible due to scale.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: opacity
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The opacity of the item.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: disableOpacityControl
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: When true, the user will be unable to change the opacity of the item

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: splitDirection
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The side of the splitter to display this imagery layer on. Defaults to both sides.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: disableSplitter
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: If true, splitter funcitonality will be hidden for this model.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: timeFilterPropertyName
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The name of a property in a feature returned from this layer's feature query service that indicates the times at which this layer covers this position. For example, historical and near-real-time satellite imagery often comes as daily swaths, with a given area on the globe potentially only covered every number of days.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: timeFilterCoordinates
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The current position picked by the user for filtering

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: timeLabel
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Time label which is shown in workbench next to date/time selector (Will default to t($ => $.dateTime.selectorLabel") = "Time:).

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: currentTime
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The current time at which to show this dataset.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: initialTimeSource
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description:
The initial time to use if Current Time is not specified. Valid values are
* start - the dataset's start time
* stop - the dataset's stop time
* now - the current system time. If the system time is after Stop Time, Stop Time is used. If the system time is before Start Time, Start Time is used.
* none - do not automatically set an initial time
This value is ignored if Current Time is specified.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: startTime
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The earliest time for which this dataset is available. This will be the start of the range shown on the timeline control.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: stopTime
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The latest time for which this dataset is available. This will be the end of the range shown on the timeline control.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: multiplier
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The multiplier to use in progressing time for this dataset. For example, 5.0 means that five seconds of dataset time will pass for each one second of real time.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: isPaused
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: True if time is currently paused for this dataset, or false if it is progressing.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: dateFormat
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description:
A dateformat string (using the dateformat package) used to adjust the presentation of the date in various spots in the UI for a catalog item.
For example, to just show the year set to 'yyyy'. Used in places like the the Workbench Item and Bottom Dock

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: url
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The base URL of the file or service.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: forceProxy
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: Force the default proxy to be used for all network requests.

WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.name: cacheDuration
WebMapServiceCatalogItemTraits.description: The cache duration to use for proxied URLs for this catalog member. If undefined, proxied URLs are effectively cachable forever. The duration is expressed as a Varnish-like duration string, such as '1d' (one day) or '10000s' (ten thousand seconds).

WebMapServiceAvailableLayerStylesTraits.name: layerName
WebMapServiceAvailableLayerStylesTraits.description: The name of the layer for which styles are available.

WebMapServiceAvailableLayerStylesTraits.name: styles
WebMapServiceAvailableLayerStylesTraits.description: The styles available for this layer.

LegendTraits.name: title
LegendTraits.description: A title to be displayed above the legend.

LegendTraits.name: url
LegendTraits.description: The URL of the legend image. If the URL suffix isn't one of the following png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg, then urlMimeType must be defined - otherwise a hyperlink will be shown.

LegendTraits.name: imageScaling
LegendTraits.description: Scaling of the legend. For example, a high DPI legend may have scaling = 0.5, so it will be scaled down 50%

LegendTraits.name: urlMimeType
LegendTraits.description: The MIME type of the URL legend image. For example "image/png"

LegendTraits.name: backgroundColor
LegendTraits.description: Apply background color to entire legend. This can be useful if legend is transparent and clashes with Terria colours. This will override legendBackgroundColor.

LegendItemTraits.name: title
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleTitles
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple titles to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: maxMultipleTitlesShowed
LegendItemTraits.description: Maximum number of multiple titles to display next to this legend item. (Default is 10)

LegendItemTraits.name: titleAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display above this legend item, i.e. marking the top of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: titleBelow
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display below this legend item, i.e. marking the bottom of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: color
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color to display for this item. This property is ignored if Legend URL is specified.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineColor
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color with which to outline this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of outline in pixels

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineStyle
LegendItemTraits.description: The style of outline using CSS outline-style values. Eg 'dotted', 'dashed', 'solid', 'double', 'groove', 'ridge', 'inset', 'outset'

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleColors
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple colors to show with this item in a grid arrangement.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageUrl
LegendItemTraits.description: The URL of an image to display with this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: marker
LegendItemTraits.description: Maki marker ID to display with this item (eg "circle").

LegendItemTraits.name: rotation
LegendItemTraits.description: The degrees to rotate legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: addSpacingAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: True to add a bit of extra spacing above this item in order to separate it visually from the rest of the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageHeight
LegendItemTraits.description: The height of the legend image.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of the legend image.

WebMapServiceAvailableLayerDimensionsTra.name: layerName
WebMapServiceAvailableLayerDimensionsTra.description: The name of the layer for which dimensions are available.

WebMapServiceAvailableLayerDimensionsTra.name: dimensions
WebMapServiceAvailableLayerDimensionsTra.description: The dimensions available for this layer.

WebMapServiceAvailableDimensionTraits.name: default
WebMapServiceAvailableDimensionTraits.description: The default value for the dimension.

WebMapServiceAvailableDimensionTraits.name: multipleValues
WebMapServiceAvailableDimensionTraits.description: Can the dimension support multiple values.

WebMapServiceAvailableDimensionTraits.name: nearestValue
WebMapServiceAvailableDimensionTraits.description: The nearest value of the dimension.

GetFeatureInfoFormat.name: type
GetFeatureInfoFormat.description: The type of response to expect from a GetFeatureInfo request.  Valid values are 'json', 'xml', 'html', 'text' or 'csv'. If type is 'csv', then featureInfoContext will contain timeSeries object (see "Customizing the Feature Info Template" in documentation)

GetFeatureInfoFormat.name: format
GetFeatureInfoFormat.description: The info format to request from the WMS server.  This is usually a MIME type such as 'application/json' or text/xml'.  If this parameter is not specified, the provider will request 'json' using 'application/json', 'xml' using 'text/xml', 'html' using 'text/html', and 'text' using 'text/plain'.

InfoSectionTraits.name: content
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section, in Markdown and HTML format. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: contentAsObject
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section which is a JSON object. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: show
InfoSectionTraits.description: Indicates if this info section showing (not collapsed).

ShortReportTraits.name: show
ShortReportTraits.description: Indicates if this short report section showing.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: url
MetadataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: title
MetadataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DataUrlTraits.name: type
DataUrlTraits.description:
Type of data URL. This value will be used to provide context or instruction on how to use the data URL. For example wcs will provide a link to WCS docs.
Current supported values are:
- wfs = A Web Feature Service (WFS) base URL
- wcs = A Web Coverage Service (WCS) base URL
- wfs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WCS server
-  wcs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WFS server
-  direct = Direct URL to dataset (this is the default if no type is specified)
-  none = Hide data URL

DataUrlTraits.name: url
DataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

DataUrlTraits.name: title
DataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DimensionOptionTraits.name: value
DimensionOptionTraits.description: Value (if this is undefined, id will be used)

WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.name: outputFormat
WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.description: File format of output (defaults to GeoTIFF).

WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.name: subsets
WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.description: Array of key-value pairs for subsets to be included in query parameters. For example {key: "Time", value: "2020"} will add query parameter subset=Time("2020")

WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.name: duplicateSubsetValues
WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.description: If multiple values have been detected for a particular subset ID (key), then we can only use the first one as WCS only supports one value per subset. Each element in this array represents the actual value used for a subset which has multiple values.

WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.name: additionalParameters
WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.description: Each key-value will be added to URL like so - someurl.com?key=value.

TileErrorHandlingTraits.name: thresholdBeforeDisablingItem
TileErrorHandlingTraits.description: The number of tile failures before disabling the item.

TileErrorHandlingTraits.name: treat403AsError
TileErrorHandlingTraits.description: Indicates whether a 403 response code when requesting a tile should be treated as an error. If false, 403s are assumed to just be missing tiles and need not be reported to the user.

TileErrorHandlingTraits.name: treat404AsError
TileErrorHandlingTraits.description: Indicates whether a 404 response code when requesting a tile should be treated as an error. If false, 404s are assumed to just be missing tiles and need not be reported to the user.

TileErrorHandlingTraits.name: ignoreUnknownTileErrors
TileErrorHandlingTraits.description: A flag indicating whether non-specific (no HTTP status code) tile errors should be ignored. This is a last resort, for dealing with odd cases such as data sources that return non-images (eg XML) with a 200 status code. No error messages will be shown to the user.

RectangleTraits.name: position

LookAtTraits.name: targetLongitude
LookAtTraits.description: Target longitude on the WGS84 ellipsoid in degrees

LookAtTraits.name: targetLatitude
LookAtTraits.description: Target latitude on the WGS84 ellipsoid in degrees

LookAtTraits.name: targetHeight
LookAtTraits.description: Target height in meters. Treat it as camera height. A positive value is above the WGS84 ellipsoid. Default to 100 meters.

LookAtTraits.name: heading
LookAtTraits.description: Heading in degrees. Treat it as camera bearing. North is 0. A positive value rotates clockwise, negative anti-clockwise. Default to 0.

LookAtTraits.name: pitch
LookAtTraits.description: Pitch in degrees. Treat it as camera pitch. A positive value is to look down, negative up. Default to 45.

LookAtTraits.name: range
LookAtTraits.description: The range in meters. It is the distance between the target position and camera position projected onto the local plane. Not negative and default to 500.

CameraTraits.description: The look direction of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

CameraTraits.description: The up vector direction of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

InitialMessageTraits.name: key
